title: Everyday Club Privileges by Northgate Membership Tier
content:
The everyday privileges that come with Northgate Memberships differ by tier in early shopping hours and fuel savings; the guest allowance is the same at every tier.

| Tier | Early shopping before regular opening (minutes) | Guests per cardholder per club visit | Discount off the posted Northgate Fuel Center price (cents per gallon) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| Northgate Club Membership | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| Northgate Business Membership | 60 | 2 | 0 |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 60 | 2 | 5 |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 60 | 2 | 5 |

## At a glance

- **Early shopping:** 60 minutes before regular opening on Business, Club Plus and Business Plus; none on the other tiers.
- **Guests:** 2 per cardholder per club visit on every tier.
- **Fuel:** 5 cents per gallon off the posted Northgate Fuel Center price on the two Plus tiers; none elsewhere.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Club Plus cardholder buying 12 gallons at the Northgate Fuel Center saves 5 cents on each gallon, 60 cents in all; a Club cardholder buying the same 12 gallons saves nothing.
